description: S458 2a-fix F2: an engine whose `for=` enum carries a refined payload field (`Dragging(id: number(>0))`) registers that enum's judge for its variant cell, so a transition that commits `.Dragging(-5)` is refused (E-CONTRACT-001-RT) and the engine stays in `.Idle`. Before, the payload was never judged.
rationale: §53.3.1: the refinement is evaluated at every binding site — a payload field binding included (§53.2.2 lists struct / enum-shaped type positions). §53.3.3: the prior value is retained.
